Localized thunderstorms brought heavy rains over Metro Manila, parts of Luzon, and Mindanao on Saturday, triggering flooding in several areas, the state weather bureau said.

In a report by Jamie Santos on "24 Oras Weekend" on Sunday, heavy rains on Saturday evening caused gutter-deep flooding in Barangay Manuyo Dos in Las Piñas City, forcing residents to wade through floodwaters.
